target_claim: Having exactly Φ_d(|A|) traces on a finite set A is sufficient, without a VC-dimension-at-most-d hypothesis, to obtain exactly Φ_d(|C'|) traces after restricting to any subset C'⊆A of the prescribed cardinality.
source_quote: Interpret $C'$ as any subset of $A$ of cardinality $|C'|$.  Then by Theorem 9 of \cite{FlWa95} again, $\sigma(C')$ is consistent.
